name: Amami Yoshie
source:
[url=/c95191]Souma[/url]'s mother.

She is fed up with life of just taking care of housework with barely enough funds to scrape by. Aware of her [url=/c95413]husband[/url] spending money on other women, she brings up divorce whenever the two are arguing. However, because she has been a housewife for all this time, she knows that single life is no longer an option at this point. She is always talking to Souma about divorce.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
